title: Finite-Tor domains for closed coefficient change
statement: For the same finite coefficient datum, closed immersion and finite-Tor input, scalar extension and both closed exceptional outputs satisfy the three finite-Tor constructibility conclusions appearing in finiteCoefficientClosedShriek.
